manifest.claim_scope: Transductive reconstruction from exposed offsets; no superiority or recursive-hierarchy claim
manifest.primary_endpoint: Fraction of clean identifiable pair queries agreeing with truth and both references within Euclidean displacement error 1e-5
manifest.disconnected_rule: Every cross-component query must return UNIDENTIFIABLE
manifest.contradiction_rule: Noisy/inconsistent residual remains positive; independently evaluated committed energy agrees with least squares within 1e-8
manifest.selection_rule: No fitting or parameter selection in C0; settings predeclared and identical across all worlds
manifest.observability: Only opaque IDs and exposed numerical offsets/weights; hidden coordinates/edges/queries remain evaluator-owned
manifest.reset_policy: New zero-initialized geometry per world; freeze before queries; no cross-world learned parameters
manifest.feedback_rules: No hidden answer feedback to candidate
manifest.query_rule: All eight hidden redundant edges are included among 64 indirect queries; exposed-pair diagnostics and cross-component queries are separate panels
manifest.historical_receipts: R001: evidence/c0_original; R002: evidence/c0_review_interrupted (stopped for additional qualification repair, not accepted); R003 uses disjoint fresh seeds
manifest.stationarity_rule: Both absolute free-node force and force divided by exposed weighted degree must be below the registered gradient tolerance; additional guard prevents tiny weights from falsely certifying wrong coordinates

predecessor_experiment: R001: evidence/c0_original; R002: evidence/c0_review_interrupted (stopped for additional qualification repair, not accepted); R003 uses disjoint fresh seeds
source_note: No Git repository; file hashes captured before and after execution
hypothesis_note: Independent hypothesis adjudication pending; C0 is a reference reconstruction experiment, with no superiority or hierarchy claim
limitations: No cross-world trained model or recursive resonators
Compiled coordinates solve clean data much more cheaply
Paired timings are wall time; query microtimings cannot establish efficiency
Numeric workspace bytes omit Python heap and temporary/peak allocations
Bootstrap intervals describe sampled worlds, not out-of-family tasks
next_action: Independent acceptance of reviewed C0 before C1
